title: How to add a new user

changes_detected: Users > Management page is titled 'Management of users' (help center 2024 says 'Seznam a správa' / 2026 'Přehled a správa').
Add opens a full page 'Create a new user' (not a dialog); required: activation status, Name, Surname, Email.
Choosing 'The user is not active' reveals the new hire packet template and language selects.
After 'Create user' the app opens the new user's profile on the 'Basic and work data' tab.

steps.narration: In this video, you'll learn how to add a new user to Sloneek and fill in their basic details.
steps.intent: No action - stay on the dashboard.
steps.must_show: The dashboard with the left menu is visible.

steps.narration: In the left menu, under Company, click Users to expand the user section.
steps.intent: In the left menu click 'Users' in the COMPANY section.

steps.narration: Then choose Management to open the list of all users in your company.
steps.must_show: The page 'Management of users' with the user table is shown.

steps.narration: Click the Add button at the top of the page to start creating a new user.
steps.intent: Click the 'Add' button on the 'Management of users' page.
steps.must_show: The page 'Create a new user' is open.

steps.narration: First, set the status. Select The user is not active, so Petra can't log in before her first day.
steps.intent: Select the radio 'The user is not active'. Leave the new hire packet template empty.
steps.must_show: 'The user is not active' is selected and the new hire packet template select appears.

steps.narration: Under Basic information, fill in the required Name and Surname fields.
steps.must_show: Name 'Petra' and Surname 'Example' are filled in.

steps.narration: Next, enter the new colleague's work email address. The Email field is required too.
steps.intent: Type a unique example.com address into 'Email' (video.demo+RUN_ID@example.com).
steps.must_show: The Email field is filled in without a validation error.

steps.narration: Optionally, assign a team. Open the Team dropdown and pick Marketing.
steps.intent: Open the 'Team' dropdown in 'Additional work data' and choose 'Marketing'.

steps.narration: When everything looks right, click Create user in the top right corner to save.
steps.must_show: The new user's profile 'Example Petra (Inactive)' opens on the 'Basic and work data' tab.

steps.narration: That's it. Petra now has her own user profile, where you can add more details anytime.
steps.intent: No action - highlight the user's name in the profile header.
steps.must_show: The profile of 'Example Petra' is still visible.
